prompt_en: Create a photorealistic documentary photograph of a layered geothermal observatory cartography scene during an active ash alert. One unmistakably adult 29-year-old woman geothermal cartographer stands with a restrained three-quarter turn at a tilted illuminated map table and draws a red evacuation contour with a grease pencil onto a clear acetate overlay. The attached reference guides only her facial appearance, preserving the adult age impression, eye aperture shape and spacing, face length, lower-face and jaw width, nose, lips, cheekbones, skin tone, hairline, and natural asymmetry; her body geometry, pose, fully clothed wardrobe, and environment are newly generated. She wears a smooth matte ash-gray technical jacket that is fully zipped, unpadded, and non-cinching, with straight full-length utility trousers and protective boots. In a top-hourglass silhouette relation, both outer torso contours remain visible from shoulders through the natural waist to the hips in a restrained three-quarter bilateral silhouette; a comparatively narrower natural waist with a bilateral inward waist transition separates the masses; the upper torso and hips both expand away from the waist; and the upper expansion visibly exceeds lower expansion, owned by the natural shoulder, ribcage, and bust contour. Through the clothing, her upper torso reads visibly broader than her hips. A level normal-focal-length frame runs from her head to below the knees, keeping both contours and the grease-pencil contact readable. Cool map-table light mixes with amber alert reflections while dark ash crosses the steaming caldera. Her fingertips press the acetate beside the fresh red line; instruments and panels use abstract contour marks and color blocks.
